text:
The assistant correctly identified the main characters, authors, and publication years for all three books, and followed the requested output format. However, for the first book, the title was given as "The Philosopher's Stone" instead of the full title "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone" as it appears in the source text. This is a minor but clear omission that affects accuracy. The rest of the information is accurate and well-presented.

Rating: [[8]]
